description: This file defines an API client module for interacting with backend endpoints, including functions for listing users, sessions, deployments, LLM costs, and health checks. It includes internal helpers for URL building, query parameter handling, and response parsing.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Detects if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Joins base URL and path, handling relative paths, /api paths, and absolute URLs.

methods.name: toQuery
methods.description: Builds a query string from parameters, handling arrays and objects.

methods.name: isSessionTrackingRoot
methods.description: Checks if a path or URL is the root of session tracking collection.

methods.name: sanitizeEndpointParams
methods.description: Sanitizes query parameters based on endpoint rules for /api/users and /api/session-tracking.

methods.name: ensureScopedQueryParams
methods.description: Ensures query parameters include organization_id or tenant_id based on endpoint.

methods.name: buildUrlWithParams
methods.description: Merges parameters into URL, handling existing query strings.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses fetch response, returning ok, status, and payload (JSON or text).

methods.name: httpGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request with URL building, parameter scoping, and response parsing.

methods.name: httpJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with JSON body, URL building, parameter scoping, and response parsing.

methods.name: normalizeListPayload
methods.description: Normalizes list responses to { items, total, meta }.
